journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: Economic Crisis and Disillusionment from Socialism: Evidence from a Quasi-Natural Experiment
articles.title_cn: 经济危机与社会主义幻灭：来自准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: While many socialist countries suffered from harsh economic crises, studying their impacts on economic and political attitudes is challenging because of the scarcity of reliable data in non-democratic contexts. We study a democratic socialist setting where we have ample information on such attitudes: the Israeli kibbutzim. Exploiting an economic crisis that hit some kibbutzim more than others, we find that the crisis led to reduced support for leftist political parties. This effect persisted for over 20 years after the crisis had ended. We document that the electoral movement was rooted in a rightward shift in economic attitudes, suggesting that economic crises may undermine socialist regimes by silently changing attitudes toward them. In our unique setting, we can also study recovery mechanisms from the crisis. First, we find that while a sharp debt relief arrangement restored trust in the leadership, it did not reverse the impact of the crisis on economic attitudes. Second, as part of their efforts to recover from the crisis, kibbutzim liberalized their labor markets. Analyzing the staggered shift away from equal sharing to market-based wages, we find that this labor market liberalization led kibbutz members to move further rightward in their political voting and economic attitudes.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管许多社会主义国家遭受了严重的经济危机，但由于非民主背景下可靠数据的稀缺，研究这些危机对经济和政治态度的影响颇具挑战性。我们研究了一个民主社会主义环境，在那里我们拥有关于此类态度的丰富信息：以色列的基布兹。利用一场对某些基布兹影响大于其他基布兹的经济危机，我们发现危机导致了对左翼政党的支持减少。这一效应在危机结束后持续了超过20年。我们记录了选举运动根源于经济态度的右转，表明经济危机可能通过悄然改变人们对社会主义制度的态度而削弱该制度。在我们独特的环境中，我们还可以研究危机的恢复机制。首先，我们发现虽然一项急剧的债务减免安排恢复了对领导层的信任，但它并未逆转危机对经济态度的影响。其次，作为从危机中恢复努力的一部分，基布兹对其劳动力市场进行了自由化改革。通过分析从平均分配到基于市场工资的错开转变，我们发现这种劳动力市场自由化导致基布兹成员在政治投票和经济态度上进一步右移。

articles.title_en: Accounting for Business Income in Measuring Top Income Shares: Integrated Accrual Approach Using Individual and Firm Data from Norway
articles.title_cn: 在衡量顶层收入份额时计入企业收入：使用挪威个人与企业数据的综合权责发生制方法
articles.abstract_en: Using linked individual and firm administrative data from Norway, we look through layers of holding companies and attribute corporate profits to the ultimate personal owner as the profits accrue rather than when income is realized. We show that our accrual-based measure of income inequality changes the level and trend of income inequality over time and eliminates the sensitivity of measures of inequality and income persistence to changing payout policies in response to tax reforms. After a tax reform in 2005 that incentivized retention of earnings within businesses, the total income share of the top 0.1% more than doubled in some years, compared with ordinary realization-based income measures. We further utilize rich data to show that (1) using our accrual-based measure of personal income reduces the estimated tax elasticity of income, and (2) observed capital income in individuals’ tax returns does not proxy well for overall corporate profits, so that an imputation method based on realized dividends, which is commonly used in the literature, performs poorly. We discuss implications for top income inequality measures in other countries. We also document the importance of indirect ownership as a mechanism behind our findings and its relevance in other developed countries and discuss implications for debates on capital income and wealth taxation.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用挪威关联的个人与企业行政数据，我们穿透多层控股公司，将企业利润归属于最终个人所有者，按利润累积而非收入实现时点进行归属。我们表明，基于权责发生制的收入不平等衡量方法改变了收入不平等随时间的水平和趋势，并消除了不平等和收入持续性衡量对税收改革响应中股利政策变化的敏感性。在2005年一项激励企业留存收益的税收改革后，顶层0.1%的总收入份额在某些年份比基于实现的普通收入衡量方法增加了一倍以上。我们进一步利用丰富的数据表明，（1）使用基于权责发生制的个人收入衡量方法降低了收入的估计税收弹性，且（2）个人纳税申报表中观察到的资本收入并不能很好地代表整体企业利润，因此文献中常用的基于已实现股息的估算方法表现不佳。我们讨论了对其他国家顶层收入不平等衡量的影响。我们还记录了间接所有权作为我们发现背后机制的重要性及其在其他发达国家的相关性，并讨论了对资本收入和财富税收辩论的影响。

articles.title_en: The Role of Caseworkers: Job Finding, Job Quality, and Determinants of Value-Added
articles.title_cn: 个案工作者的作用：就业寻找、工作质量与增值的决定因素
articles.abstract_en: We study the importance of caseworkers and their role in supporting unemployed job seekers. By exploiting as-if random variation, arising from job seekers in Sweden being assigned to caseworkers based on their date of birth, we estimate caseworker value-added along several dimensions. We show that caseworkers have meaningful effects on both job seekers’ time in unemployment and subsequent job quality. These effects also impact job seekers’ long-run outcomes. We find only weak trade-offs between different dimensions of value added. Leveraging detailed administrative data on both caseworkers and job seekers, we document that experienced caseworkers perform better than their less experienced counterparts. Caseworker work strategies are important in determining value added, and matching caseworkers to job seekers based on previous labor market experiences leads to better outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究个案工作者在支持失业求职者中的重要性及其作用。通过利用瑞典求职者基于出生日期被分配至个案工作者所产生的似随机变异，我们从多个维度估计了个案工作者的增值效应。我们表明，个案工作者对求职者的失业时长及后续工作质量均有显著影响。这些效应也影响求职者的长期结果。我们发现不同增值维度之间仅存在微弱的权衡关系。利用关于个案工作者和求职者的详细行政数据，我们记录到经验丰富的个案工作者比经验较少的同行表现更佳。个案工作者的工作策略在决定增值方面至关重要，而根据过往劳动力市场经验将个案工作者与求职者匹配可带来更好的结果。

articles.title_en: From Sea to Shore: The Impact of Ocean Acidification on Child Health
articles.title_cn: 从海洋到岸边：海洋酸化对儿童健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: Since the Industrial Revolution, ocean water acidity has risen by 26% due to anthropogenic emissions—a process known as ocean acidification—posing a risk for marine life and the communities depending on it. This paper examines the consequences of ocean acidification for child health, using data from coastal regions in 36 low- and middle-income countries from 1972 to 2018, encompassing 41% of the world’s coastal population. Leveraging short-term exogenous shifts in ocean acidity near human settlements for identification, we find that prenatal exposure to higher water acidity significantly raises the risk of death in the first months of life and impacts early childhood development. We show evidence consistent with these effects being associated with maternal malnutrition, as increased acidity reduces catches for small-scale fisheries, increasing seafood prices and reducing consumption of crucial nutrients. Our findings indicate limited adaptation to these impacts. We estimate that, absent intervention, ocean acidification could contribute to as many as 77 million neonatal deaths in this region by 2100—a consequence that should not be ignored in the projected cost of climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 自工业革命以来，由于人为排放，海洋水体的酸度上升了26%——这一过程被称为海洋酸化——对海洋生物及其依赖的社区构成风险。本文利用1972年至2018年间36个中低收入国家沿海地区的数据，涵盖了世界沿海人口的41%，考察了海洋酸化对儿童健康的影响。利用人类聚居地附近海洋酸度的短期外生变化进行识别，我们发现产前暴露于较高的水体酸度显著增加了出生后最初几个月的死亡风险，并影响幼儿期发展。我们提供的证据表明，这些影响与母亲营养不良有关，因为酸度增加减少了小规模渔业的捕捞量，提高了海产品价格并减少了关键营养素的摄入。我们的研究结果表明，对这些影响的适应能力有限。我们估计，若无干预，到2100年，海洋酸化可能导致该地区多达77百万新生儿死亡——这一后果在气候变化的预计成本中不应被忽视。

articles.title_en: A Political Economy of Social Discrimination
articles.title_cn: 社会歧视的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the causes and consequences of social discrimination. We consider a labor market in which payoff-irrelevant identity traits can shape hiring decisions. Identity is malleable, and a majority group member can become socially associated with the minority group. Fear of identity contagion can sustain a fully segregated labor market in which workers with minority trait experience higher unemployment and minority-owned firms are less productive than their majority counterparts. When the minority group is poorly integrated economically (consisting of more workers than employers), workers with majority trait obtain better labor market outcomes in an equilibrium with discrimination than without. Office-motivated candidates therefore have electoral incentives to propose symbolic policies targeting the minority to trigger social discrimination in the labor market. As majority-trait workers are better off with social discrimination and the economy shrinks, the implementation of symbolic policies is associated with both lower taxes and less redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社会歧视的原因与后果。我们考虑一个劳动力市场，其中与报酬无关的身份特征可以影响雇佣决策。身份是可塑的，多数群体成员可能在社会上与少数群体产生关联。对身份传染的恐惧可以维持一个完全隔离的劳动力市场，在该市场中，具有少数群体特征的工人面临更高的失业率，少数群体拥有的企业生产率低于多数群体企业。当少数群体在经济上整合不足（工人多于雇主）时，具有多数群体特征的工人在存在歧视的均衡中比在没有歧视的情况下获得更好的劳动力市场结果。因此，以职位为导向的候选人具有选举激励，提出针对少数群体的象征性政策，以在劳动力市场中引发社会歧视。由于具有多数群体特征的工人因社会歧视而境况更好，且经济规模缩小，象征性政策的实施与较低的税收和较少的再分配相关联。

articles.title_en: Leveraging Social Comparisons: The Role of Peer Assignment Policies for Productivity and Stress
articles.title_cn: 利用社会比较：同伴分配政策对生产力和压力的作用
articles.abstract_en: Using a large-scale real effort experiment, we explore whether and how different peer assignment mechanisms affect worker performance and stress. Letting individuals choose whom to compare to increases productivity to the same extent as a targeted exogenous matching policy designed to maximize motivational spillovers. These effects are significantly larger than those obtained through random assignment and their magnitude is comparable to the impact of an increase in pay of about 10 percent. A downside of targeted peer assignment is that, unlike endogenous peer selection, it leads to a large increase in stress. The key advantage of letting workers choose whom to compare to is that it allows those workers who want to be motivated to compare to a motivating peer while also permitting those for whom social comparisons have little benefits or are too stressful to avoid them. Finally, we show that social comparisons yield stronger motivational effects than comparable non-social goals.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过一项大规模的真实努力实验，我们探讨了不同的同伴分配机制是否以及如何影响工人的表现和压力。让个体选择与谁比较，其生产力提升程度与旨在最大化动机溢出的定向外生匹配政策相同。这些效应显著大于随机分配所获得的效应，其幅度与增加约10%薪酬的影响相当。定向同伴分配的一个缺点是，与内生同伴选择不同，它会导致压力大幅增加。让工人选择与谁比较的关键优势在于，它允许那些希望被激励的工人与激励性同伴进行比较，同时也允许那些社会比较益处不大或压力过大的人避免这种比较。最后，我们表明，社会比较产生的动机效应强于类似的非社会目标。

articles.abstract_en: Using unique data covering the entire population of sole proprietorships in Italy with their respective audit files, we examine the role of tax advisors in tax compliance. Exploiting quasi-random variation in audit policy, we document that tax advisors act as information hubs, gathering privileged information on the auditing policy from their activities and incorporating it into the tax return strategy of their clients. The heterogeneity in tax advisors’ willingness to serve this role establishes a market for intermediated tax evasion, in which taxpayers sort themselves on the basis of the tax advisors’ tolerance for it.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖意大利全部个体工商户及其相应审计文件的独特数据，我们考察了税务顾问在税收合规中的作用。利用审计政策中的准随机变化，我们记录了税务顾问作为信息枢纽的行为，他们从自身活动中收集关于审计政策的特权信息，并将其纳入客户的纳税申报策略中。税务顾问在承担这一角色意愿上的异质性，建立了一个中介逃税市场，在该市场中，纳税人根据税务顾问对此的容忍度进行自我选择。

articles.title_cn: 自我合理化均衡：存在性与计算
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces the concept of self-justified equilibria as a tractable alternative to rational expectations equilibria in stochastic general equilibrium models with heterogeneous agents. A self-justified equilibrium is a temporary equilibrium where, in each period, agents trade assets and commodities to maximize the sum of their current utility and expected future utilities, which are forecasted based on current endogenous variables and the current exogenous shock. The agents’ forecasting functions are assumed to be mean-squared optimal forecasts within a given compact, finite-dimensional set of functions. We provide sufficient conditions for the existence of self-justified equilibria and develop a simulation-based computational method to approximate them. By leveraging active subspace methods, we reduce the dimensionality of the problem, lower computational complexity, and improve forecasting accuracy, thereby mitigating the curse of dimensionality. We apply our method to high-dimensional overlapping generations models with aggregate shocks, demonstrating that self-justified equilibria can be efficiently computed to analyze complex economic models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了自我合理化均衡的概念，作为异质性主体随机一般均衡模型中理性预期均衡的一种易处理的替代方案。自我合理化均衡是一种临时均衡，在每个时期，主体交易资产和商品以最大化其当前效用与预期未来效用之和，这些预期基于当前内生变量和当前外生冲击进行预测。主体的预测函数被假定为在给定的紧致有限维函数集合内的均方最优预测。我们为自我合理化均衡的存在性提供了充分条件，并开发了一种基于模拟的计算方法来近似这些均衡。通过利用活动子空间方法，我们降低了问题的维度，减少了计算复杂度，并提高了预测准确性，从而缓解了维度灾难。我们将我们的方法应用于具有总体冲击的高维重叠世代模型，证明了自我合理化均衡可以被高效计算以分析复杂的经济模型。

articles.title_en: Wealth and its Distribution in Germany, 1895–2021
articles.title_cn: 德国的财富及其分布，1895-2021年
articles.abstract_en: German history over the past 125 years has been turbulent. Marked by two world wars, revolutions and major regime changes, as well as a hyperinflation and three currency reforms, expropriations and territorial divisions, it comprises extreme shocks to study the role of historical events, taxation, asset price changes, portfolio heterogeneity in affecting the wealth distribution in the long run. Combining tax and archival data, household surveys, historical national accounts, and rich lists, we document that the top 1% wealth share has fallen by half, from close to 50% in 1895 to 26% today. Nearly all of this decline was the result of changes that occurred between 1914 and 1952. Using a novel decomposition framework, we show that collapsing equity prices after World War I and in the Great Depression as well as taxation in the aftermath of World War II stand out as great equalizers in 20th century German history. After unification in 1990, two trends have left their mark on the German wealth distribution. Households at the top made substantial capital gains from rising business wealth while the middle-class had large capital gains in the housing market. The wealth share of the bottom 50% has halved since 1990. Our findings speak to the importance of historical shocks to the valuation of existing wealth and taxation in driving the evolution of the wealth distribution over the long run. In addition, our data revisions reveal that Germany’s current wealth–income ratio is about 120 percentage points higher than previously thought.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去125年的德国历史动荡不安。经历了两次世界大战、革命和重大政权更迭，以及恶性通货膨胀和三次货币改革、征用和领土分裂，这些极端冲击为研究历史事件、税收、资产价格变化、投资组合异质性在长期影响财富分布中的作用提供了素材。结合税收和档案数据、家庭调查、历史国民账户和富豪榜，我们发现前1%的财富份额减少了一半，从1895年的接近50%降至今天的26%。几乎所有这些下降都是1914年至1952年间发生的变化的结果。使用一种新颖的分解框架，我们表明第一次世界大战后和大萧条时期的股票价格崩溃以及第二次世界大战后的税收，在20世纪的德国历史中凸显为伟大的均衡器。1990年统一后，两种趋势在德国财富分布上留下了印记。顶层的家庭从企业财富增长中获得了可观的资本收益，而中产阶级在住房市场中获得了大量资本收益。自1990年以来，底层50%的财富份额减半。我们的发现说明了历史冲击对现有财富估值和税收在长期财富分布演变中的重要性。此外，我们的数据修订显示，德国当前的财富-收入比率比之前认为的高出约120个百分点。

articles.title_en: The Common Good and Voter Polarization
articles.abstract_en: Do voters see democracy entirely in spatial terms, as a tradeoff of conflicting interests, or do they also view it as a search for the “common good”, as some democracy theorists have long conjectured? We develop a model in which voters have preferences over both common-good and spatial payoffs, and provide a novel method to disentangle the two. Estimating the model on California ballot propositions from 1986 to 2020, we find that 74% of voters placed significant weight on the common good and that partisan polarization roughly doubled over the time period, mainly due to Democrats drifting left.
articles.abstract_cn: 选民是否完全以空间术语来看待民主，将其视为冲突利益的权衡，还是他们也像一些民主理论家长期以来所猜想的那样，将其视为对“共同利益”的追求？我们开发了一个模型，其中选民对共同利益和空间收益都有偏好，并提供了一种新颖的方法来区分这两者。在1986年至2020年的加州选票提案上估计该模型，我们发现74%的选民对共同利益给予了显著权重，且党派极化在该时间段内大约翻倍，主要归因于民主党向左偏移。
